products.name: Woven Labels

garments_trade_rules: Stock is tracked per VARIANT (colour/width/size/pack), never per product.
Units: pcs, dozen, gross, thousand, roll, cone, kg, yard, metre, with pack conversion.
Orders and invoices carry optional Buyer/Brand, Buyer PO no. and Style no.; stock movements copy them.
Delivery challan is printed with each delivery.
Customers buy on credit: credit days, credit limit, due balance, ledger.
Payments in BDT via cash, bKash, Nagad, bank, cheque. Amounts shown with the BDT symbol and Indian-style grouping (1,84,500).
Names accept Bangla text; PDF prints must embed a Bangla-capable font (Hind Siliguri / Noto Sans Bengali).
Not included: online cart/payment, full accounting, payroll, production planning, multi-branch, barcode scanner hardware, customer portal, mobile app.

database.engine: MySQL 5.7+ / MariaDB 10.3+ on the same cPanel hosting (InnoDB, utf8mb4). No third-party database.
database.import_order: phpMyAdmin > Import NRE_mysql_schema.sql, then NRE_mysql_seed.sql, into an empty database created in cPanel.
database.no_triggers_or_procedures: All logic (numbering, totals, stock posting, permissions, audit) is in PHP services inside DB transactions. See NRE_BACKEND_API.md section 4 for exact SQL recipes.
rules_for_backend: Only StockService inserts into stock_movements; the table is append-only (never UPDATE/DELETE).
Every multi-table change runs in one transaction; lock rows in ascending id order.
Document numbers come from doc_counters with UPDATE ... LAST_INSERT_ID(last_number+1) inside the same transaction.
Invoice subtotal, tax_amount, total, paid_amount and status are written only by InvoiceService/PaymentService.
variant_costs, purchase order rates and profit are never returned to staff.
Invoices and invoice_items are editable only while status = 'draft'.
Public endpoints return only is_active/show_on_website/published rows and never any price or cost.
Use prepared statements only; money and quantities are returned as decimal strings.
rules_for_frontend: The browser never talks to MySQL. It calls /api/v1 only, through one typed API client (src/lib/api.ts).
Do not compute or send invoice totals, balances, statuses or document numbers; display what the API returns.
Hide cost columns and manager-only menu items by role from /auth/me, but never rely on hiding for security.
Format money as BDT with en-IN grouping using a decimal-safe helper; do not sum floating point numbers for final totals.
VITE_USE_MOCK=true switches the API client to an in-memory mock built from nre-project-spec.json so Lovable can preview without the PHP backend.
database.seed: 3 categories, 19 products with one default variant each (SKU = product code + -STD), 46 product image rows, 20 clients (permission_confirmed=0), 6 UNPUBLISHED certifications, company settings, units, document counters. No users are seeded: the first registered user becomes admin.

Invoice + items + payments + challans + customer + company print block (bank, BIN, footer).
Only while draft (409 otherwise). Replaces header and items.
Transaction: lock invoice, check stock per line (message names the item), insert sale_out movements, set status due/partial/paid, due_date = date + credit_days, mark linked order invoiced.
{reason}. Blocked if payments exist. Inserts cancel_reverse movements for confirmed invoices.
{quantity, note}. Stock back in + credit_note payment for the line value.
{payment_date, method, reference_no, amount (<= balance), note}. Receipt RC-0001; resyncs invoice paid/status.
Query: customer_id, from, to, method, page.
Query: status, supplier_id, from, to, page.
v_pending_receipts (NO prices). Visible to all roles.
{quantity <= pending, batch_no?, note?}. Updates qty_received, inserts purchase_in movement, sets PO partial/received.
{quantity <= received, note}. purchase_return_out movement; reduces qty_received.
Low/out variants with last purchase rate (v_last_purchase_rate).
{sales, cost, profit}; sales = SUM(subtotal - discount) of confirmed invoices; cost = SUM(qty * current purchase_price).
Streams the private file after auth check.
Creates a quotation (customer_id or new customer payload), sets enquiry converted_order_id and status quoted.
Set role (admin|manager|staff|null), is_active, full_name; bumps token_version when deactivated. Cannot remove the last admin.
Query: table, user_id, action, from, to, page.
